results.title: Exploring students' perceptions of GenAI tools in higher ...
results.content: The incorporation of GenAI instruments, such as ChatGPT, Grammarly and AI-enhanced research assistants, presents substantial prospects for individualized educational experiences, heightened student participation and improved academic productivity (Fleischmann, Citation2024). Institutional support must extend beyond technology tools to include structured academic methodologies that facilitate the integration of GenAI into teaching and learning procedures in order to maximize its efficacy (Hoernig et al., Citation2024). Furthermore, incorporating ethical concerns into the curriculum promotes responsible AI use while empowering students to make educated decisions that improve academic success (Bates et al., Citation2020; Wecks et al., Citation2024). Within educational settings, student satisfaction with GenAI tools is regarded as a critical factor in fostering academic engagement and ensuring the sustained use of these technologies (Alshammari & Babu, Citation2025). Future studies should examine how faculty and students use AI literacy, how much GenAI tools are integrated into pedagogical frameworks and the technological difficulties of using GenAI in educational settings.
